content: Licensed tabletop role-playing games provide players with a new way to experience their favorite franchises like Star Wars, Star Trek, and the Lord of the Rings. But those adventures always come with a big question about how player characters are supposed to make their mark on stories that already have their own legendary heroes. Rather than erasing canon characters or turning them into quest-givers, the wildly ambitious Mistborn Legacy campaign for the Cosmere Roleplaying Game allows players to forge legends as powerful as any of Brandon Sanderson’s characters.
